verdict.rationale: Runpod documents an agent skills plugin that lets you ask your coding agent, in natural language, to create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, or deploy code with Flash. It also ships two official MCP servers that connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod resource management, plus agent slash-commands like `/runpod:migrate rest`. Missing for 10: no native natural-language interface in Runpod's own console (it depends on a third-party coding agent), and no independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language operations work reliably.
